name: Cafe Chica
why_it_matters: Set on the lawns of the Abbotsford heritage homestay above Mallital, looking across to the Kumaon ranges — Nainital's only boutique cafe in a colonial bungalow setting. Named after the owner's pug Chica; ingredients are from the on-site garden where possible.
insider_tip: It's the only dog-friendly cafe in Kumaon and walk-ins aren't always accommodated — call ahead, especially in season. Wednesdays and Thursdays close at 7:30pm.
signature_address: Abbotsford, Prasada Bhawan, Mallital, Above High Court, ahead of Vikram Vintage Hotel, Nainital 263001

name: The Cask Cafe & Bar
why_it_matters: Sukhatal-side cafe roughly 800m off Mall Road — the largest cafe in Nainital and one of the few stocking single-origin Indian beans alongside a full bar. Indoor mezzanine plus a Sukhatal-facing terrace; the lake here is a separate, quieter water body from Naini.
insider_tip: Park at Sukhatal and walk down — Mall Road traffic to the lake-end is throttled in season, but Sukhatal entry from the bypass stays open. Ask for the Coorg or Chikmagalur pour-over.
signature_address: 13, Sukhatal, Mallital, opposite Cave Garden, Nainital 263001

name: Mantra Cafe
why_it_matters: A poet-run cafe in the pine forests of Bhujia Ghat on the Nainital approach road, owned by Alok Singh (ex-Reliance, now full-time host). In-house library, merchandise shelf, occasional live-music nights, valley-facing rooftop — a deliberate contrast to Mall Road's crowds.
insider_tip: If you're driving in from Kathgodam or Haldwani, this is the last serious meal stop before town — book ahead on weekends or you'll wait. The library is browseable; bring a book to swap.

name: Coffee Maven The Cafe
why_it_matters: A coffee-forward cafe at Bhujia Ghat — Nainital's only spot positioning itself explicitly around the bean (sourcing, brewing methods, espresso work) rather than as a multi-cuisine restaurant. Sister branch in Haldwani Lamachaur.
insider_tip: Skip the food menu and order whatever single-estate they're brewing that week — it's where the kitchen actually puts effort. Highway pull-in on the Bareilly-Nainital stretch makes it convenient for arrivals.
signature_address: Bhujighat, Dogda, Bareilly-Nainital Road, Kathgodam, Nainital 263139
